value.content: Welcome to NewTabNote! 🚀
This is a block-based note-taking app designed for speed and productivity. Every paragraph, image, or list is a "block" that you can move, change, or delete.
Quick Start
Daily Notes: Click the 📅 icon in the sidebar or press Alt+D to open today's note.
Slash Commands: Type / in any empty block to see all available block types.
Check off this todo item
Create a new note from the sidebar
Try It Out
Drag & Drop: Grab the ⠿ handle on the left of any block to reorder it.
Try the slash command menu by typing /
Code Blocks
console.log("Hello from NewTabNote!");
You can add code snippets with syntax highlighting:
AI Powered Features
Smart Sidebar: Click the ✨ button to chat with your notes or see proactive insights.
Semantic Search: Find notes by meaning, not just keywords.
We've integrated AI to help you organize your thoughts.
Organization
Folders: Create folders in the sidebar and drag notes into them.
Backlinks: Use [[Note Name]] to link notes together.
Happy note-taking! ✨
{{CANARY:code-block}}
